laura (prod): Quick triage: we need a short, customer-impact-first backlog for enterprise compliance by Friday. Focus areas: audit exports, BYOK onboarding path, SOC2 evidence packaging. Who can take a cut? @ryan @nidhi

 ryan (security): I can lead the BYOK threat model and acceptance criteria. Short ask: decide whether non-HSM handshake is allowed in pilot. My recommendation: allow pilot non-HSM, require HSM for contract commitments.

 nidhi (infra): I'll inventory storage/indexing gaps for 1y vs 90d searchable. Quick note: 1y searchable needs sharded hot indexes, ~2-3 infra tickets. Exports to customer S3 are cheaper but bring complexity for integrity proofs.

 mike (sales): Customers keep pushing for "searchable-year". A few strategic deals require 7y cold export guarantees. We should list those accounts and mark as "high-touch".

 ana (legal): For SOC2, evidence packaging must include signed manifest and chain-of-custody. I'll draft a short template clause for pilots — need security input on manifest fields.

 ops-bot: Reminder: compliance-playbook v1.4 updated at 2026-02-02T14:10Z. Link: https://redwood.internal/compliance/playbook

 laura (prod): Proposal for prioritization: 1) export SLA + signed manifest (high impact, M effort), 2) BYOK non-HSM pilot + attestation flow (high impact, S effort), 3) 1y searchable (medium impact, L effort), 4) HSM-escrow + rotation (enterprise, XL effort). Thoughts?

 ryan (security): Agree. Add: fallback behavior if BYOK key unavailable (runtime fallback policy) must be explicit in SLA.

 nidhi (infra): I'll scope infra tasks for items 1-3 and post effort estimates by Wed. Also will prototype a manifest signing flow using KMS.

 ana (legal): I'll share pilot clause by Thu morning. Will include manifest requirements and acceptance tests for evidence retrieval.

 mike (sales): I'll produce a customer matrix (who needs HSM day1) and recommended concessions.

 laura (prod): Action items captured. I'll produce the prioritization doc and link tickets. Closing thread unless blockers.
